bagPolicy.summary: Comerica Park allows single-compartment bags, wallets, and clutches smaller than 4" x 6" x 1.5". Larger bags are prohibited, except for medical and diaper bags up to 16" x 16" x 8".
allowed: Single-compartment bags smaller than 4" x 6" x 1.5"
Medical bags up to 16" x 16" x 8"
Diaper bags up to 16" x 16" x 8"
prohibited: Beverages (except juice boxes for children or medical needs)
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are exceptions and can be up to 16" x 16" x 8".

parking.note: With 32 parking locations available within The District Detroit, parking is less than a 10-minute walk from Comerica Park. Event parking opens 3 hours before and closes 2 hours after events. Parking is credit card only, with no in/out privileges.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Comerica Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Comerica Park offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including local favorites and unique twists on traditional ballpark fare. Highlights include Smashburger, health-conscious wraps, and BBQ sandwiches from Slows Bar BQ. Fans can also enjoy rotating local food trucks on weekends and themed concessions on Heritage Nights.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The preferred accessible drop-off and pick up locations are at the intersections Adams Ave and Witherell Street. Accessible Ticket Windows are available at Gate A - A1, A2, A14, A15; Tiger Club Lobby A17 (in-house future game purchase); Gate Gallagher Entry - C25.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Comerica Park's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticketed guests unable to be assisted by the box office will be directed to the main Guest Service office located behind section 130. WHAT: Tigers fans may pick up wristbands tomorrow, Friday, February 28 for the opportunity to purchase tickets at the Comerica Park box office on Saturday, March 1 at 10 a.m.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Comerica Park. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
